note: Whether RouterOS enforces uniqueness on a field, established by creating a row and then attempting a second row that differs in everything except that field. UNIQUE = the second create was rejected and the message names the field. DUPLICATE = it succeeded, so the field does not identify a row and addressing by it can match two. AMBIGUOUS = it was rejected for some other reason, which is not evidence either way. UNPROBED = no row could be created at all, with the router's last refusal as the detail. Absence of a verdict is not absence of a constraint; it means this program could not establish one. Reproducibility: two consecutive runs against the same CHR agreed on 404 of 407 verdicts; the difference was /interface/6to4, which takes a row only sometimes on this guest.
